text_simplified: The issue of involuntary urination (bedwetting) may appear in children aged 4–6 years, where a child may lose control over the urination process. This problem can occur due to various reasons, such as anxiety or changes in daily routine.
title: Eliminating Involuntary Urination in Children Aged 4–6 Years
